name: Vinegar (distilled, wine, balsamic, cider, rice)

Cd.binding_scope: liquid foods in general except categories with particular limits

tAs.binding_scope: liquid foods in general except categories with particular limits

iAs.rationale: No sovereign inorganic-arsenic ML exists for vinegar; total arsenic is governed (200, Vietnam). Inorganic arsenic is the toxic species, obtained by reflex speciation on any elevated total arsenic.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; reflex iAs speciation (HPLC-ICP-MS) on any total-As exceedance.

MeHg.rationale: Vinegar is a fermented fruit- or grain-derived acid with no aquatic methylation pathway and no fish source. Total mercury is governed (50, Vietnam).

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for vinegar, but an acidic food in prolonged contact with stainless steel (fermentation and storage vessels, tubing) leaches nickel. Because a real migration pathway exists, the cell is held under a reflex screen rather than declared not-material.
Ni.reference_method: Total nickel by ICP-MS on each lot; monitored under ALARA against the tightest available food nickel context.

Cr.rationale: No sovereign total-chromium ML exists for vinegar, but an acidic food in prolonged stainless-steel contact leaches chromium alongside nickel. Held under a reflex screen; any total-chromium exceedance triggers Cr(VI) speciation.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; vinegar is sold in glass or plastic, not tinplate. A canned/tinned acidic product would fall under the canned-food tin ML and is out of this subcategory's scope.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for vinegar and no aluminium pathway operates in a bottled acid. Rebuttable and audited each build.

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default; face value, no reconstitution; read-across / control / not-material for unregulated cells; no occurrence percentiles)
lineage_note: Vietnam QCVN 8-2 sets vinegar-specific MLs (Pb 500, tHg 50) and governs those cells directly. Cadmium and total arsenic are governed instead by the stricter Uruguay RBN general limit for LIQUID foods (Cd 100, tAs 100; uy_rbn_general_cd_liquid_foods_0_1mgkg / uy_rbn_general_tas_liquid_foods_0_1mgkg) — a national catch-all that binds every liquid food without a particular limit and is tighter than the Vietnam vinegar values (Cd 1000, tAs 200). Hidden-hazard flag for the ratchet, NOT a missing limit: the FDA has issued balsamic- and wine-vinegar lead warning letters (grape-derived lead concentrated during must reduction, compounded historically by lead-bearing equipment), and measured balsamic lead can approach or exceed 500 ug/kg — so ALARA and the occurrence ratchet drive tightening after publication even though the sovereign ceiling is the correct initial value. Nickel and total chromium are held under a stainless-steel-migration screen because an acidic food in prolonged stainless contact leaches both.
